_readme: The one list of edit styles and tools. The launcher reads it, and Claude reads it to rank formats and to know how to build each one. status: ready = an engine here already makes this; draft = recipe written, first real edit will shape it. editor = root pipeline (renders with HyperFrames; no Remotion) (.claude/skills rough-cut, graphics-plan, captions, export; HyperFrames), legacy = engines/legacy-editor skills, content-os = the Content OS folder outside Video Studio (see CLAUDE.md). altEngine: the optional Remotion engine for this style (see styles/engines.json); statusWithRemotion: its status when Remotion is on. scriptShape: how the script is written for this format (styles/SCRIPT-SHAPES.md); alsoScriptShape: other shapes that fit. video-fx = engines/video-fx (Remotion effects with a person cut-out); `fx` is the effect: skill fx-<fx>, preview engines/video-fx/examples/NN-<fx>.mp4.
